dataset: European time sources — NTS / IPv6 / stratum

measured_from.role: our own AS — the only one we operate
our office ISP — we are a customer, we do not run it

method.nts: THREE states. yes = ALPN ntske/1 negotiated AND certificate valid FOR THE NAME QUERIED. cert-invalid = ALPN passes but certificate issued for another name: a conforming client refuses (RFC 8915 mandates validation). no = closed/silent/no NTS-KE. An open port proves nothing; a negotiated ALPN proves nothing either.
method.ipv6: AAAA published AND effective NTP reply.
method.reachable_from: X/6 — a server reachable from only some of the six ASes is marked PARTIAL, not reachable. 3 servers are partial, including our own Stratum 1 (4/6).

counting_rule: Deduplicated BY RESOLVED IP (several hostnames = same machine). Pool zones excluded. Filter counted=true to reproduce the figures. Aliases are kept with alias_of pointing at the counted machine.

counts.note_on_country_counts: Country counts exclude two pseudo-categories: 'International' (worldwide anycast: Cloudflare, Google, Apple...) and 'Unknown' (names that no longer resolve and whose location we cannot evidence — we do not infer a country from an operator's name). A country enters the count only once at least one machine has been observed there. Filter counted=true AND country NOT IN ('International','Unknown') to reproduce them.

limits: Central and Eastern Europe only partially probed — a KNOWN GAP, not a measured fact.
GARR (IT) and DFN (DE) publish no public NTP server: verified.
vantage_independence: Five of the six observation networks are NOT ours. Only AS206014 is operated by RDEM. A measurement taken solely from one's own network would prove little; the convergence of six independent networks is what makes the figure defensible.
